_purpose: Inventory + provenance for every file in tests/fixtures/. The repository carries evidence for every pinned adapter contract; the honest limit of that evidence is recorded per file, so no test may claim 'recorded from the live service' unless live_capture is true.
vendored_snapshot_root: (read-only local mirror of the upstream projects, downloaded 2026-09-07; convenience for offline reading, not an authority)
citation_register: docs/provenance/upstream-references.md — the in-repo register of what each upstream source says, pinned by commit and re-checkable with scripts/check_upstream_citations.py
live_capture_policy: exactly one fixture here is a genuine capture from a live service: gna_verifications_live.json, recorded by scripts/record_live_gna.py and re-checkable with `--check`. Everything else is source-derived or synthetic and says so. A fixture may only be marked live_capture true if the recording tool, endpoint and timestamp are recorded in its own _provenance and re-derivable by anyone without credentials.
outstanding_live_captures: lpsn_advanced_search_live.json — needs LPSN credentials (PROKNAME_LPSN_USER/PASSWORD); record via the scheduled CI live-smoke job
lpsn_status_live.json — the label enumeration above cross-checked against a live response; required before any 'verified: false' row in src/prokname/data/lpsn_status.json may be flipped to true
seqcode_registry_live.json — the SeqCode REST contract; see dedup/seqcode.py m0_flip_checklist()
completed_live_captures: gna_verifications_live.json — recorded 2026-09-25 from the live GNverifier service; closes the M2 'confirm one live response still matches this schema' gate in src/prokname/dedup/gna.py

pins: record field 'full_name' (bare name, no author citation)
count == 0 with a 'count' key in client.result ⇒ genuine not_found
payload without 'count' ⇒ rejected query ⇒ unavailable, never not_found
every label must appear in src/prokname/data/lpsn_status.json
every label must classify to a non-'unknown' category, and the two negated 'not/non-validly published' labels must NOT read as valid

gna_verifications_exact.json.kind: trimmed copy of an upstream-recorded HTTP fixture
pins: entry.matchType + bestResult.matchType + editDistance co-occurrence on an Exact hit

gna_verifications_fuzzy.json.derived_from: gnverifier names.yaml:15 (field names) + gnmatcher/internal/testdata/testdata.csv:1-5 (Fuzzy* vocabulary, editDistance) + gnverifier/fuzzy-matching.md:25-30
pins: a fuzzy hit must never be reported as occupancy (found_near_match)
a missing editDistance must render as 'n/a', not as an empty placeholder

gna_verifications_live.json.kind: live capture (untrimmed responses from the running GNverifier service)
gna_verifications_live.json.derived_from: POST https://verifier.globalnames.org/api/v1/verifications, recorded 2026-09-25 by scripts/record_live_gna.py with the same body the adapter sends (withAllMatches false)
pins: an Exact entry with an Exact bestResult and editDistance 0 rules as found_reference, not not_found
the service really does emit the entry-level matchType words Exact / Fuzzy / NoMatch (the vendored names.yaml sample only carried Exact and NoMatch)
a Fuzzy bestResult rules as found_near_match and is never read as occupancy (that finding)
a NoMatch entry carries no bestResult at all, which is what makes 'not found' distinguishable from 'could not ask'
the field names gna.check() reads (matchType, bestResult.matchType, bestResult.editDistance, matchedName, currentName, dataSourceTitleShort, isSynonym) still exist upstream

ncbi_names_tiny.dmp.kind: synthetic names.dmp sample (no real NCBI rows)
ncbi_names_tiny.dmp.derived_from: field layout from src/prokname/dedup/ncbi.py docstring and scripts/rebuild_corpus.py:344-361; name_class VALUE LIST from the NCBI taxdump README (NOT vendored — hence the semantics table in dedup/ncbi.py marks every row verified: false)
pins: 'authority' is a citation, not a synonym
multiple rows for one name merge by name_class PRIORITY, not file order
